newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia peso weakens as banks square positions.
newsitem.headline: Colombia peso weakens as banks square positions.

text.p: Colombia's peso weakened by 4.6 pesos to 1,111.8 against the dollar on Wednesday as banks squared their month-end positions, interbank traders said.
"There was quite a lot of volatility with heavy demand for dollars but few greenbacks coming on to the market," one dealer said.
"Coffee growers were speculating and banks were squaring positions but there was no demand from industry," he added.
The peso opened at 1,107.5 and moved to an intraday high of 1,107.4 before sinking to a low of 1,113.25. Dealers reported 445 trades worth a higher-than-average $244 million.
